newsitem.title: USA: Northwest names chief operating officer.
newsitem.headline: Northwest names chief operating officer.

text.p: Northwest Pipe Co said Monday it has appointed Brian Dunham as chief operating officer.

Dunham was formerly chief financial officer. Dunham, who has been with Northwest Pipe for seven years, will be responsible for all aspects of profitability, including manufacturing, sales and marketing and other corporate functions for the company.
The company also said in a statement it has appointed John Murakami, formerly the corporate controller, as its new chief financial officer.
"These changes will position the company for future growth," said Bill Tagmyer, Northwest Pipe's president and chief executive officer.
